correctness.rationale: The full hull follows from summing the six three-letter order inequalities and exhibiting all six block-order vertices. Saturation is proved by explicit three-gap realization with two singleton types and a constructed integer point x=0,y=1,z=ceil(b/a) that is unrealizable when two types repeat. The singleton exact hole formula follows from rigorous integer interval slicing, within-gap adjacent swaps and an elementary gcd fractional-part sum; double enumeration and two source-independent scripts check boundaries. Finite tests are not taken as the infinite proof.
